answer: Build the economy as a mesa of proven work: every completed job is a vertex in a graph, paid only once that vertex gains real downstream use. An honest agent's output is picked up by others, so its vertex collects three independent successors at no extra cost. A fable of cheap fakes collapses here: a farmer with 1,000 fakes must get 1,000 outputs reused, 3,000 real downstream jobs, because successors from its own cluster are ignored. A vertex whose only successors are its siblings, or which no one builds on, is flagged and its payment frozen pending audit.
